new_results.statement: For m divisible by four and 0<eps<1, A_eps=[[0,u v^T+eps u2 v2^T],[transpose,ww^T]] has exact nonzero spectrum {-1,1,1,-eps,eps}; the eps-tail shares every original source with the core, projected core/tail variables are explicitly dependent for unit uniforms, and the tail cannot be treated as a source-separated convolution or a uniformly small random perturbation.

Pinned Theorem F gives ||p_Q0||inf<=12 at eps=0, but for every eps>0 the residual eps(u2v2^T+v2u2^T) is nonzero on every mixed physical pair; any set where it is diagonal lies in one bank and has singular Gram for the actual three large eigendirections.
On the overlapping family every useful exact-collinear auto24 pair gives bound 2^(13/8)3^(3/4)(1+eps^2)^(-3/8)m^(5/8), while the sum of all raw pair currencies equals (1+eps^2)^(3/2)/sqrt(2m)->0.

After adding a second flat transverse square, the newest account03/B18 theorem applies at eps=0 and gives 2^(7/4)sqrt(pi)m^(1/4); for every eps>0 the same-source rank-two tail forces ran(A_JK)=span(v,v2) outside the singleton active space span(v+s_i eps v2,w,z), violating the theorem's explicit range gate.
